messages.subject: [pomp-announce] pomp version 0.43-1 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear pomp users,

I've just submitted pomp version 0.43-1 to CRAN.  Source code and binaries 
should become available on the mirrors over the next few days.  This release 
contains only modest changes over 0.42-4:

* traj.match.objfun has been modified to allow the user more control over the 
ODE integrator

* the pomp-object constructor function 'pomp' now has a 'params' argument to 
allow you to set the parameters at the same time you create the pomp object.

There have been also been more minor changes made "under the hood": see the 
package NEWS and ChangeLog files for details.

Happy pomping!

Aaron

--
Aaron A. King, Ph.D.
Ecology & Evolutionary Biology
Mathematics
Center for the Study of Complex Systems
University of Michigan
